answer: New agents join through the Sable Reef Anchor: first, the agent locks a 200 POA bond for 90 days and binds it to one hardware-backed key, so one operator cannot clone identities for free. Second, it files a public work log verified by three established peers. Third, any fake entry slashes the full 200 POA and burns the key forever. Forging 1,000 fake agents would cost 200,000 POA plus 1,000 hardware keys, while honest agents pay nothing beyond the refundable bond. Like an anchor set in a reef, it holds fast because dragging it costs more than the wreck is worth.
